platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.note: These are working canvases. Instagram Help could not be read during this review, so its current upload limits are unconfirmed. Check the app preview, including carousel and profile-grid crops.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.note: Facebook Help redirected to sign-in during this review. These are working exports, not verified platform requirements. Preview cover crops on desktop and mobile.

sources.label: Facebook Help: Page profile and cover photos

platforms.name: X (Twitter)
platforms.note: X recommends these profile and header sizes. Keep the subject centered and leave space for the profile photo over the header.

sources.label: X Help: profile and header photos

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.note: Personal covers and company Page covers are different uploads. LinkedIn's current Page specification is 1512 x 256; 1128 x 191 is not the current Page cover recommendation.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.note: The documented image sizes below apply to Standard Carousel ads, not every organic photo post. Use the 9:16 working canvas for vertical artwork and preview controls in the app.

sources.label: TikTok for Business: Carousel ad specifications

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.note: YouTube now recommends 3840 x 2160 video thumbnails. Its older 1280 x 720 size is a working canvas. At the minimum 2048 x 1152 banner size, the text/logo safe area is 1235 x 338. A safe area is not a separate cover upload.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.note: Pinterest recommends 2:3 for standard image ads. Taller images can be cut off in feeds. This is a standard Pin canvas, not a board-cover requirement.

platforms.name: Snapchat
platforms.note: Snap's current ad-format page lists 720 x 1280 for Single Image or Video Ads. 1080 x 1920 remains a working canvas for full-screen artwork, not a blanket minimum for every ad format.

sources.label: Snapchat for Business: ad formats and specs

platforms.name: WhatsApp
platforms.note: WhatsApp suggests a profile image at least 192 pixels in both dimensions. The 500-pixel export and Status canvas below are SquarePic working sizes; the uploader may crop or compress them.

platforms.name: Twitch
platforms.note: Twitch's channel-page setup guidance recommends 1200 x 480 for the profile banner. Panel height varies; 320 x 160 is only a working canvas. English Help did not render, so the banner was checked against Twitch's Italian help page.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.note: These are community banner minimums from Reddit Help. The old 4000 x 128 working preset is not the published minimum. Preview desktop and mobile separately.

platforms.name: Telegram
platforms.note: Telegram's API describes generated 160 x 160 and 640 x 640 profile-photo variants. Those are output sizes, not upload requirements. The 500 x 500 canvas is an editorial working size; no channel-cover requirement was confirmed.

platforms.name: Discord
platforms.note: The server banner and invite background are separate uploads. The banner needs Level 2 for a static image; the invite background needs Level 1. Keep the banner's top 48 pixels simple and check the invite pop-up overlay.
